comparison.objective: Move two museum tankards one at a time by their bodies onto padded marked spots.
comparison.physical_skill: Rule-constrained grasp selection and sequential fragile-object transport.
comparison.success_condition: Use body grasps, never lift by handle or rim, never have both objects off the table together, and place both on their spots. Exact placement thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests conservation handling rules and grasp semantics, not coaxial tools, impact control, or recovery of fractured parts.
